title: [IMP2-20] Pinning cannot work in DM groups
description: Review finding IMP2-20: Pinning cannot work in DM groups (lens IMP2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:445, :465; spec/14-jmap.md:62, :153. Fix: 14:153 already says that without a sequencer, `sequenced-v1` types are read-only, and DM groups have no sequencer. State at 05:445 that pins are unavailable in DM groups, and drop "in a group chat, admins". The single-author last-writer-wins alternative would add a mechanism where the existing rule already decides. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
